name: Women Scientist Scheme-C
benefit:
1. ₹ 35,000/- per month for Ph.D. in Basic or Applied Sciences/MD or equivalent degree.
1. ₹ 30,000/- per month for M.Phil / M.Tech / M.Pharm / M.VSc or equivalent degree.
1. ₹ 25,000/- per month  for M.Sc in Basic or Applied Sciences / MBBS / B.Tech or equivalent degree.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant must be a female.
1. The applicant must have a break in her career.
1. The age of the applicant must be between 27 and 45 years.
1. Minimum Educational Qualification must be either Master of Science or Bachelors in Engineering / Technology or equivalent.
